== Description ==

The Players Committee glass World Championship trophy on display at the [[2025 World Championship]] in SeaTac, Washington, on 3 October 2025.

* '''Source:''' Star Wars CCG Slack, #2025-world-championship-seattle, Teacher, 3 October 2025 (13:40 PDT): "Who will take it home?". Original file name: IMG_8107.jpg (4032×3024); Slack file id F09JM2NCFF0.
* '''Shared by:''' Teacher (Slack)
* '''Date:''' 3 October 2025 (Slack post date).
* '''Identification:''' No people in the photograph.
